origin: D3S6 B Gate0 independently reloaded GLB art reject
objective: An inhabited sectional city in which one actual lived path leads from public fabrication to research observation to semiprivate garden and private residence, where the same physical roof/floor/wall shapes the large public void and urban silhouette
stop_list: do not reuse the D3S6 low campus from one-XYZ witness
do not use five solid nonhabitable fake OCCUPIED bays
do not add loft towers, giant arches, decorative roofs or thin separate slab bridges
do not say that separate hand-drawn 2D crops equal same 3D camera
do not count a clear center ray as a usable research view

hard_gates.name: 0A coherent eye-level art
measures: maker truly makes large work inside sheltered public civic room
research actually sees the same activity through unobstructed full view from supported floor
resident sees urban garden through real private threshold and not own floor
city both sides reads original multi-district futuristic metropolis, not a low campus

hard_gates.name: 0B occupied actual human route
measures: one traversable corridor maker to research with real stairs/ramp/elevator
one secure access from semipublic garden to dwelling; prior private floor-to-garden z gap 11 units must be solved with physical geometry
real inhabitable M/R/L interiors; NO closed solid occupancy placeholders
independent route and floor tests incl point-in-solid adversarial negative controls

hard_gates.name: I 3D coherence
measures: GLB export and actual independent reimport
same true real triangles act as roof/floor in both M/R and R/L borders
3 independent human eye views and actual front/reverse sky views on same saved GLB

hard_gates.name: II two public internal room axes
measures: two nonparallel occupied-thickness public room axes with genuine walls, roofs and real supported floor
fully realized level transfer, full-width human body path sweeps

hard_gates.name: III formal QA only after art gate
measures: traditional 331 body / 993 foot locations and G0/S1/G1/G2/G3 in distinct strict stages
false technical success not artistic approval
